lessons.title: Ordering Drinks

items.exampleMeaning: I want a glass of water.
Can you bring me a coffee, please?

lessons.tip: In Spanish, it's common to use 'por favor' to make your requests polite. Always remember to say 'gracias' after receiving something.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.meaning: What do you want to drink?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.meaning: I want a coffee, please.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.meaning: Anything else?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.meaning: Yes, an orange juice.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Aquí tienes tu café y tu jugo.
dialogue.meaning: Here is your coffee and juice.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.meaning: Thank you, very kind.

scenario.partnerRole: A café staff member who takes orders.
scenario.brief: Ask the customer what they want to drink. Offer options and confirm their order politely.
scenario.goal: You will order a drink politely.

lessons.title: Ordering Food

items.exampleMeaning: Do you have soup of the day?

lessons.tip: Use 'gracias' to express your gratitude after receiving food or drinks. It's polite and appreciated.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.meaning: What would you like to eat?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Me gustaría una ensalada, por favor.
dialogue.meaning: I would like a salad, please.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.meaning: And for the main course?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.meaning: I want roasted chicken.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Aquí está tu ensalada y tu pollo.
dialogue.meaning: Here is your salad and chicken.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.meaning: Thank you, it looks delicious.

scenario.partnerRole: A café staff member who takes orders.
scenario.brief: Ask the customer what they would like to eat. Confirm their order and serve them.

lessons.title: Using Numbers

items.exampleMeaning: I need two glasses of water.
I want four pieces of bread.

lessons.tip: Numbers in Spanish are essential for ordering. Practice counting from one to ten to help with your orders.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.meaning: How many do you want?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.meaning: I want two beers, please.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.meaning: And how many loaves of bread?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.meaning: I want four loaves of bread.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Aquí tienes tus cervezas y tus panes.
dialogue.meaning: Here are your beers and loaves of bread.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.meaning: Thank you, that is perfect.

scenario.partnerRole: A café staff member who takes orders.
scenario.brief: Ask the customer how many items they want. Take their order using numbers.
scenario.goal: You will order multiple items using numbers.

lessons.title: Polite Conversations

items.exampleMeaning: How much does the coffee cost?

lessons.tip: Use polite phrases like '¿Cuánto cuesta?' to ask about prices. It shows respect and interest.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.meaning: Do you like the coffee?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.meaning: Yes, it is very good.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.meaning: How much does the salad cost?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.meaning: I don't know, but it is delicious.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.meaning: Is everything perfect?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.meaning: Yes, how tasty!

scenario.partnerRole: A café staff member who engages in friendly conversation.
scenario.brief: Ask the customer how they like their food and drinks. Engage in polite conversation.
scenario.goal: You will have a polite conversation about your order.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.meaning: What do you want to drink?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Quiero un café y un jugo, por favor.
dialogue.meaning: I want a coffee and a juice, please.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.meaning: How many loaves of bread do you want?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.meaning: I want three loaves of bread.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.meaning: How much does the chicken cost?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.meaning: I don't know, but it is delicious.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Aquí tienes tu comida y bebida.
dialogue.meaning: Here is your food and drink.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.meaning: Thank you, everything is perfect.

scenario.partnerRole: A café staff member who engages in conversation.
scenario.learnerRole: A customer ordering drinks and food.
scenario.brief: Use your knowledge from the chapter to confidently order drinks and food while having a polite conversation.
scenario.goal: You will demonstrate your ability to order and converse in a café setting.
